name: Florin's Grandson
summary: Old Florin prays every day that his grandson, who went up the castle road for work two winters ago, doesn't come back.

stages.journal: Old Florin's grandson Tudorel went up the castle road to ask for work two winters ago and never came back. Florin says he prays the boy doesn't. A coin comes by the carter every month, with no name on it.
objectives: Find out what became of Tudorel
stages.hint: Look for Tudorel among the servants of Vallaki: Lady Wachter's household keeps footmen in grey-and-black livery. If her house has fallen, he waits in the market square; if she rules the town, he is with her in the burgomaster's mansion.

stages.journal: Tudorel is alive: a footman in Lady Wachter's house in Vallaki, in the count's livery, warm and fed and ashamed. He sends his grandfather a coin a month by the carter. He asked us to tell Florin whatever will be kindest.
objectives: Decide what to tell Old Florin
stages.hint: Go back to Old Florin, praying in the church in the Village of Barovia, and tell him what became of his grandson.

stages.journal: We told Old Florin what we chose to tell him about Tudorel. He took it the way he took it, and the coin still comes every month.
